name: MT45
summary: MT45 is a trend-following Expert Advisor that uses moving average crossover signals filtered by ADX strength to enter trades in the direction of the prevailing trend. It includes optional trailing stop functionality and ATR-based stop loss management for dynamic risk control. The EA operates systematically on multiple timeframes with configurable parameters for MA periods, ADX thresholds, and position sizing.
summary_zh: MT45是一个趋势跟踪智能交易系统，使用移动平均线交叉信号配合ADX强度过滤来顺趋势方向入场交易。它包含可选的追踪止损功能和基于ATR的动态止损管理，用于动态风险控制。该EA可在多个周期上系统化运行，提供MA周期、ADX阈值和仓位管理的可配置参数。
strategy_analysis: MT45的核心策略是基于移动平均线交叉的趋势跟踪系统。入场条件：当快速MA上穿慢速MA且ADX值超过设定阈值时开多单，反之当快速MA下穿慢速MA且ADX确认趋势强度时开空单。出场条件：采用ATR倍数作为止损距离，同时提供追踪止损功能以锁定利润。仓位管理使用固定手数或基于资金的百分比计算。资金管理方面提供了最大持仓限制和单笔最大亏损控制参数。该策略的优势在于ADX过滤可以有效避免震荡行情中的虚假信号，但趋势行情结束后可能产生较大回撤。
strategy_analysis_en: MT45's core strategy is a trend following system based on moving average crossovers. Entry conditions: a long position is opened when the fast MA crosses above the slow MA and the ADX value exceeds the configured threshold, while a short position is opened when the fast MA crosses below the slow MA with ADX confirming trend strength. Exit conditions: an ATR multiple is used as the stop loss distance, and an optional trailing stop function locks in profits as the trend progresses. Position sizing supports both fixed lot sizes and percentage-based calculations relative to account equity. Money management includes parameters for maximum open positions and per-trade maximum loss limits. The strategy benefits from ADX filtering which effectively avoids false signals during ranging markets, but may experience significant drawdowns when trending phases end abruptly.

pros: ADX过滤有效减少震荡市中的虚假信号，提高信号质量
ATR动态止损根据市场波动自动调整，适应不同行情环境
多参数可配置性强，允许交易者根据不同品种和时间框架优化策略
趋势跟踪逻辑清晰简单，易于理解和维护
追踪止损功能帮助锁定趋势利润，避免利润回吐
pros_en: ADX filtering effectively reduces false signals in ranging markets, improving signal quality
ATR-based dynamic stop loss automatically adjusts to market volatility, adapting to different market conditions
High configurability with multiple parameters allows traders to optimize for different instruments and timeframes
Clear and simple trend following logic that is easy to understand and maintain
Trailing stop function helps lock in trend profits and prevents profit givebacks
cons: 趋势跟踪策略在震荡行情中容易产生连续亏损
缺乏交易时间过滤，可能在低流动性时段产生不利入场
没有点差过滤，在点差较大时仍会开仓
固定手数模式缺乏动态仓位调整能力
MA交叉信号具有滞后性，入场价格可能不够理想
cons_en: Trend following strategy prone to consecutive losses in ranging/sideways markets
Lacks trading session filter, may enter positions during low liquidity periods
No spread filter, opens positions even when spread is wide
Fixed lot size mode lacks dynamic position sizing capability
MA crossover signals have inherent lag, entry prices may not be optimal
improvements: 增加交易时段过滤，避免在低流动性时段交易
加入点差检查，当点差超过阈值时暂停开仓
增加基于账户风险的动态仓位计算模式
improvements_en: Add trading session filter to avoid trading during low liquidity periods
Add spread check to pause new entries when spread exceeds a threshold
Add dynamic position sizing mode based on account risk percentage

risk_points: 缺乏点差过滤，高波动时段点差扩大可能导致额外滑点损失
趋势结束后MA交叉信号滞后可能导致较大止损触发
多持仓同时开放可能放大账户风险敞口
risk_points_en: Lack of spread filter may cause additional slippage losses during high volatility periods when spreads widen
MA crossover signal lag after trend ends may trigger large stop losses
Multiple simultaneous positions may amplify account risk exposure
